senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; perh. contr. of <cite ref="M02062"><he>מעגל</he></cite> , v. <cite ref="P00089"><he>עָגַל</he></cite>)
מַגַּל קציר or מ׳ sickle, scythe, an implement with indentations.
units: <cite ref="Sukkah 32a:1">Succ. 32ᵃ</cite> <he>עקום דומה למ׳</he> a Lulab curved like a sickle. Y. ib. III, 53ᶜ bot. <he>עשוייה כמין מ׳</he> leaves shaped (and serried) like a sickle; Bab.
<cite ref="Sukkah 34a:6">ib. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>עלה שלה עגול ופיה דומה למ׳</he>; a. e.

senses.gloss: מַגַּל יד or מ׳ an implement combining knife and saw.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 4:3">Bets. IV, 3</cite> (used for splitting wood); a. fr.—
